subject: Copywriting
title: The Inverted Pyramid
description: A micro-lesson that makes The Inverted Pyramid usable.

hook.text: Journalists put the most important fact first. Email copywriters should too. The pyramid is widest at the top.

buildup.text: Average email reading time is 11 seconds. If the first sentence doesn't hook, the rest is never read.

discovery.text: The inverted pyramid: lead with the value, then provide context, then the CTA. Most emails fail by burying the point.

twist.text: Many marketers write emails like essays—building to a conclusion. But readers don't scroll. They scan.

climax.text: Amazon's internal emails are famously blunt: the point first, the evidence second. Bezos calls them 'narratives.'

punchline.text: Eleven seconds. Lead with the point or lose the reader.

quiz.question: What is the average time someone spends reading an email?
